howto: Choose which sums to practise (+, -, × and ÷) and a level, then press Start.
Work out the sum at the top and tap the bubble with the answer, or press 1 to 4.
Right answers build your combo. Bubbles that float away cost 2 seconds. The round lasts 60 seconds.
tips: A wrong tap circles the right bubble for a moment: use it to learn the fact.
Pop the ice bubble to freeze every bubble for 3 seconds.
The +5 bubble adds five seconds to the clock.
Your combo multiplies every answer, so steady beats fast.
Turn off the kinds of sums you have mastered to practise the tricky ones.

controls.keyboard: 1 to 4 pop the bubbles from left to right. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a bubble to pop it

difficulty: Five level bands with an age guide: Easy (ages 5-6, sums to 18), Medium (7-8), Hard (9-10, times tables to 12), Insane (11-12) and Max (13+). Harder bands unlock with XP, and bubbles speed up as the score climbs.

features.age-or-level-bands: Level buttons on the title, each with an age guide, plus a choice of +, -, × and ÷
features.hints: A wrong tap circles the right bubble; the arcade Hint gives a strategy for the current sum (count on, make a ten, split and double, times tables)
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: answers and accuracy per level, practice days, the sums missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first round (the bubbles and the clock wait); replay with Learn to play
features.results: Time's Up card with score, best, max combo, golden bubbles and totals for each kind of sum
